ImageDescription.value:
Totally love this thing.

How could I live without it for this long? Drop in the frozen hash brown patties. Shower. And it's ready when I'm all dressed and ready to go. Will try bacon and other stuff today. Also got brocoli, asparagus, steaks, hush puppies... just experiment time. Boss gave me a pork chop to die for. And I wonder if it can do kale chips right for once. And, yet, I should be eating more salads.

Mozzarella sticks came out great. Found a site with a nice cheatsheet for common things to airfry.

I think I'm going to like this thing.
